sentences.en: Methods:The imaging features in 63 adults with acute miliary tuberculosis were retrospectively studied.

sentences.en: Nodules in miliary tuberculosis would not likely appear this large and tend to be more numerous.

sentences.en: As in patients with miliary metastases, the small nodules can sometimes be seen in relation to small pulmonary vessels, an appearance that reflects their mode of dissemination.

sentences.en: Objective:Summarized the imaging and clinical features in 63 adults with acute miliary tuberculosis.
